title: Israel Rejects Flydubai's Bid to Resume Commercial Flights After Cockpit Attack
detail: Israel's government has rejected a bid by flydubai to resume commercial flights to Israel following a recent attack on a cockpit of one of the airline's aircraft. The Netanyahu government's decision reflects continued security concerns around Israeli aviation in the context of the ongoing conflict stemming from the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack. The ruling comes as Israel marks the third anniversary of the massacre.

media.caption: Israel rejects flydubai's bid to resume flights after cockpit attack

title: Israel Marks Third Anniversary of October 7 Hamas Attack with National Commemorations
detail: Israel holds commemorations across the country to mark the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attacks, with events taking place amid ongoing military operations in Gaza. The anniversary comes as the nation reflects on the deadliest day for Jewish people since the Holocaust, with ceremonies honoring the approximately 1,200 victims and the hostages taken that day.

media.caption: Israel marks the third anniversary of the October 7 Hamas attacks with national commemorations
